name: Apex Sweeper
storyline:
Born from the ashes of the Eggman War and Zombot Crisis, this one of a kind city is growing rapidly and attracting tech-minded individuals from all over Mobius. It bursts with opportunity for honest and dishonest folk alike.

Are one who lives in the light? Are you one who skulks in darkness? Or maybe... One who lives in-between?

Arm yourself of wits, patience and an open mind. Firth City is home to many peculiar individuals and powerful factions, which you will eventually befriend or run afoul of while running your Sweeper Agency.

If you ever feel stuck, fret not. Your trusty Codex and Partner will be there to guide to the next step in the investigation.
summary: A visual novel based on the Sonic the Hedgehog comics from IDW. Take control of a detective who has woken up one day as an amnesiac, and meet faces both new and old as you solve mysteries throughout Firth City.
